facts.text: The only major-college player of the 2010s to score 1000 points: Jimmer Fredette, 2010-11 — 1,068 pts in 37 games.
The only major-college player of the 2010s to block 160 shots: Anthony Davis, 2011-12 — 186 blocks.
The only major-college player of the 2010s to record 80 steals and 80 blocks: Matisse Thybulle, 2018-19 — 126 stl, 82 blk.
Only two major-college players of the 2010s made 150 threes: Fletcher Magee (2018-19: 158 threes); Akeem Richmond (2013-14: 155 threes).
The only major-college team of the 2010s to lose every game (15+ games): Grambling, 2012-13 — 0-28.
The only major-college player of the 2010s to average 14 rebounds a game (15+ games): Kenneth Faried, 2010-11 — 14.5 rpg.
The only major-college player of the 2010s to average 4 steals a game (15+ games): Tra-Deon Hollins, 2015-16 — 4.0 spg.

Just four major-college players of the 2010s dished out 300 assists: Kendall Marshall (2011-12: 351 assists); Ja Morant (2018-19: 331 assists); Scott Machado (2011-12: 327 assists); Kay Felder (2015-16: 324 assists).
Just four major-college teams of the 2010s made 400 threes as a team: Villanova (2017-18: 464 threes); Auburn (2018-19: 454 threes); North Florida (2015-16: 411 threes); Akron (2015-16: 409 threes).
Only two major-college teams of the 2010s lost just once (20+ games): Kentucky (2014-15: 38-1); Wichita St. (2013-14: 35-1).
Only two major-college players of the 2010s averaged 25 points a game as a freshman (15+ games): Trae Young (2017-18: 27.4 ppg); Antoine Davis (2018-19: 26.1 ppg).
Only two major-college players of the 2010s averaged 10 assists a game (15+ games): Ja Morant (2018-19: 10.0 apg); Jason Brickman (2013-14: 10.0 apg).
Just three major-college players of the 2010s averaged 28 points a game (15+ games): Chris Clemons (2018-19: 30.1 ppg); Marcus Keene (2016-17: 30.0 ppg); Jimmer Fredette (2010-11: 28.9 ppg).
Most 12-rebound-per-game seasons (15+ games) in the 2010s: Rokas Gustys, 3 (2015-16, 2016-17, 2017-18).
Most 7-assist-per-game seasons (15+ games) in the 2010s: Jason Brickman, 3 (2011-12, 2012-13, 2013-14).
Most 3-block-per-game seasons (15+ games) in the 2010s: Damian Eargle, 3 (2010-11, 2011-12, 2012-13).
12 major-college players made 100 threes as a freshman in the 2010s. The most extreme: Antoine Davis, 2018-19 — 132 threes.
Highest scoring average in a season in the 2010s: Chris Clemons, Campbell, 2018-19 — 30.1 ppg.
Most points in a season in the 2010s: Jimmer Fredette, Brigham Young, 2010-11 — 1,068.
Most 12-rebound-per-game seasons (15+ games) by one school's players in the 2010s: Hofstra, 3 (Rokas Gustys).
Highest rebounding average in a season in the 2010s: Kenneth Faried, Morehead State, 2010-11 — 14.5 rpg.
Most 200-free-throw seasons by one school's players in the 2010s: Brigham Young, 4 (Jimmer Fredette, Eric Mika, Tyler Haws).
Most free throws made in a season in the 2010s: James Daniel, Howard, 2015-16 — 280.
Best field-goal percentage in a season (200+ attempts) in the 2010s: Devontae Cacok, UNC Wilmington, 2016-17 — 0.8%.
Best free-throw percentage in a season (100+ attempts) in the 2010s: Terrell Gomez, Cal State Northridge, 2019-20 — 0.948%.
Most 7-assist-per-game seasons (15+ games) by one school's players in the 2010s: Ohio, 4 (Jaaron Simmons, D.J. Cooper, Jason Preston).
Highest blocks average in a season in the 2010s: William Mosley, Northwestern State, 2010-11 — 4.9 bpg.
Highest steals average in a season in the 2010s: Tra-Deon Hollins, Omaha, 2015-16 — 4.0 spg.
Most threes in a season in the 2010s: Fletcher Magee, Wofford, 2018-19 — 158.
Most losses in a season in the 2010s: Towson, 2011-12 — 1-31.
Best team field-goal percentage in a season in the 2010s: Gonzaga, 2018-19 — 0.526%.
Most team threes in a season in the 2010s: Villanova, 2017-18 — 464.
Most points of the 2010s: Chris Clemons, 3,225.
Most rebounds of the 2010s: Angel Delgado, 1,455.
Most free throws made in the 2010s: Mike Daum, 786.
Most assists of the 2010s: Jason Brickman, 1,009.
Most threes of the 2010s: Fletcher Magee, 509.
Most blocks of the 2010s: Reggie Lynch, 369.
Most steals of the 2010s: Briante Weber, 374.
Exactly one major-college player of the 2010s finished a season with between 990 and 999 points, just shy of 1,000: Chris Clemons (2018-19).
10 major-college teams won 35 games in the 2010s (13 seasons). The most extreme: Kentucky, 2014-15 — 38-1.
34 major-college teams lost 27 games in the 2010s (48 seasons). The most extreme: Towson, 2011-12 — 1-31.

method: College basketball (men's): each line is one Stathead (Sports Reference college basketball) Season Finder query over the decade's ten seasons (a decade is the seasons starting in its years: the 1970s run 1970-71 to 1979-80), run in a signed-in subscriber session; result rows and stable ids are stored as provenance.

Sports Reference's season finders begin with 1947-48, so the 1940s page covers two seasons and earlier decades are not in the record. Rebounds, assists, steals, blocks and the three-pointer (1986-87) arrive at different times; rules on a stat a season lacks return nothing. Per-game figures are totals divided by games.
